verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26378326 from Dongguan Precision Housings to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318744 (order dated 2026-09-21). Two lines for the same material CMP-GAM-010 (Statue "The Getaway"), 8,500 and 9,000 units at 88.38 CNY, both confirmed for 2026-12-28. Terms: FOB Yantian, NET30. No handwriting or corrections.
red_flags: Items 00010 and 00020 are both for CMP-GAM-010 at the same price and date, which splits the order into two lines (total 17,500 units). Check this against the PO.
The document has no issue date. The only date is the order date 2026-09-21.
The document shows no PO quantity, so confirmed quantities cannot be compared with the order from this document alone.
observations: Clean printed single page with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The Qty column is not labelled as confirmed or ordered. I recorded it as quantity_confirmed because this is an order confirmation.
Only the Confirmed column holds a date, and I recorded it as date_confirmed.
